batch: BitLocker wizard desktop shortcut metadata resolution
finding: The current-user desktop shortcut path resolver expanded environment variables by assigning the resolved paths back into the catalog operation hashtable. Read-only state inspection could therefore mutate in-memory operation metadata.

change.behavior: Return a resolved shortcut descriptor containing destination path, target, arguments, description and working directory. State inspection and creation consume the descriptor without changing the operation hashtable.
change.regressionTest: tests/DesktopShortcuts.Tests.ps1 checks catalog metadata preservation, resolved paths and rejection of unsupported shortcut metadata without opening COM or writing a shortcut.

pester.reason: PowerShell 7 exposes Pester 3.4.0; Pester 5.7.1 import remains blocked in Windows PowerShell by AuthorizationManager.

windowsVm.reason: RIDE-Win11-Test access failed at host CIM before VM or checkpoint inspection.

resolved: Path normalization no longer mutates catalog metadata during shortcut-state inspection.
partial: DesktopShortcut engine lifecycle, shortcut ownership behavior and disposable Windows 11 acceptance remain pending.
deferred: Pester regression execution and actual Windows Script Host shortcut create, inspect, remove and recovery acceptance on RIDE-Win11-Test.

estimates.adjustment: None; the resolver defect is corrected, but native shortcut lifecycle acceptance and the legacy outcome remain open.
